title: CF Meet Messaging common v1
description: Messaging vocabulary and messages (Part V Workstreams C–D): error envelope, security profiles, protocol / cipher suite, devices and their PUBLIC MLS material, registration challenges, KeyPackage publication, the key-transparency tree head and proofs, conversations, context classes, lifecycle, policies. Never a private key, group secret, ciphertext or plaintext content. 1.16.0: conversation retentionSeconds / expiryGraceSeconds, pin expiry (PinRequest), ThreadSummary. 1.17.0: usage types REALTIME_CONNECTION (SECONDS), ATTACHMENT_EGRESS (BYTES), SEARCH_QUERY (QUERIES). 1.18.0: successor conversations (predecessorConversationId / successorConversationId, profileChangeDisclosureAcknowledged). 1.19.0: member roles MODERATOR / READ_ONLY / BOT_SERVICE, invitations (INVITED state, InvitationList), member authoritySource.

Error.description: Error envelope. Messages never contain key material, ciphertext, content, a credential or database text.

SecurityProfile.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: client-side MLS 1.0 encryption, the server holds no decryption key. MANAGED: server-processable, never presented as E2EE.

registrationBinding.description: The exact RFC 9420 application_id leaf extension the registration KeyPackage must carry.

credentialIdentity.description: The exact BasicCredential identity of every KeyPackage of the device.

RegistrationChallenge.description: A single-use registration challenge with a server-assigned device id.

keyPackage.description: base64url of the registration KeyPackage (RFC 9420 MLSMessage, wire format mls_key_package).

signaturePublicKey.description: base64url Ed25519 MLS signature PUBLIC key (32 bytes).

Device.description: A Messaging device: PUBLIC key material only (never a private key).

logId.description: The deployment's key-transparency log (stable across key rotation); signed.

timestamp.description: When this head was produced (RFC 3339, microseconds).

timestampMicros.description: The same instant in Unix microseconds: exactly what the signature covers.

keyId.description: First 8 bytes (hex) of SHA-256 of the log's Ed25519 public key, which clients pin out of band.

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature (64 bytes) over the length-prefixed encoding of label 'cfmeet-messaging-kt-tree-head:v1', logId, treeSize (u64 BE), rootHash and timestampMicros (i64 BE) — packages/messaging-crypto transparency::tree_head_signing_input / verify_tree_head_signature (Part V G.5).

witnessStatus.description: WITNESSED only when at least witnessQuorum distinct configured witnesses cosigned exactly this head (verify with packages/messaging-crypto transparency::verify_witnessed_tree_head against witness keys you pin). UNWITNESSED: verifiable but not, by itself, anti-equivocation.

witnessQuorum.description: Distinct witness cosignatures this deployment requires for WITNESSED (0: no witnesses configured).

cosignatures.description: Witness cosignatures of exactly this head (logId, treeSize, rootHash, timestampMicros), each already verified by Messaging under the witness's pinned key; clients verify them again.

TreeHead.description: A SIGNED tree head (Part V G.5) with the cosignatures of independent key-transparency witnesses (AD-05). The log signing key is a server secret distinct from the service-authentication key. A witness cosigns a head only after verifying the log signature and a consistency proof from the last head it cosigned, so a quorum of witnesses prevents the log from showing different views.

leafData.description: base64url of the exact leaf bytes the log hashed (canonical JSON).

ContextClass.description: Generic context classes; a product's order, trip, consultation or case is only an opaque ContextRef.

ContextRef.description: An opaque reference in the application's own namespace. Never authority, never a membership grant.

managedDisclosureAcknowledged.description: Regulated contexts: creating a MANAGED conversation requires acknowledging that the server can read its content (refused otherwise with MANAGED_DISCLOSURE_REQUIRED).

expiryGraceSeconds.description: §38: requires an expiring conversation. Past expiresAt the conversation refuses new messages (CONVERSATION_NOT_ACTIVE / EXPIRED) but stays readable and extendable for this many seconds before it becomes EXPIRED.

retentionSeconds.description: §90 / disappearing messages: a conversation-specific retention, never looser than the context's (or environment's) retention policy (RETENTION_LOOSER_THAN_POLICY). The retention worker expires older messages (tombstone, then purge unless a legal hold protects them); clients delete locally on the same timer. Audited.

predecessorConversationId.description: Appendix G: create a deliberate SUCCESSOR of this conversation (the only way to move to another security profile). The caller must be an ACTIVE OWNER / ADMIN of it; same context class (DIRECT: the same two principals); never a context-bound conversation (SUCCESSOR_CONTEXT_BOUND); one successor each (SUCCESSOR_EXISTS). No content and no members are copied.

profileChangeDisclosureAcknowledged.description: Required (true) when the successor's security profile differs from its predecessor's; refused otherwise with SECURITY_PROFILE_NOT_ALLOWED / PROFILE_CHANGE_DISCLOSURE_REQUIRED. Clients show the change (e.g. end-to-end encrypted to server-readable) before acknowledging.

CreateConversationRequest.description: A tenant / application / environment is never part of a request: it comes from the authenticated credential.

members.description: The first 100 ACTIVE members (owner, administrators, then members); page through GET /v1/conversations/{id}/members for the rest (membersTruncated).

Conversation.description: The canonical Conversation aggregate. PRIVATE_E2EE: MLS 1.0 with the server-assigned 32-byte MLS group id; serverCanReadContent is false. MANAGED: no MLS binding; serverCanReadContent is true.

retentionSeconds.description: §90 / disappearing messages: a conversation-specific retention, never looser than the context's (or environment's) retention policy (RETENTION_LOOSER_THAN_POLICY). The retention worker expires older messages (tombstone, then purge unless a legal hold protects them); clients delete locally on the same timer. Audited. Only ever tightens (RETENTION_ONLY_TIGHTENS).

UpdateConversationRequest.description: Optimistic concurrency on the aggregate version. EXPIRED is set by the server only. A security profile can never be changed (SECURITY_PROFILE_IMMUTABLE).

centralArchiveRequired.description: Only MANAGED is allowed (allowedProfiles must be [MANAGED]); an E2EE conversation can never be archived by the server.

exportsEnabled.description: Requires MANAGED; the server never exports E2EE plaintext.

smsBridgeEligible.description: Requires MANAGED among allowedProfiles; SMS is never end-to-end encrypted.

ApplicationPolicy.description: An application environment's overrides of the platform defaults. MANAGED is available for a context only when listed here.

smsBridgeEligible.description: A MANAGED conversation of this context may be bridged to SMS (default: whenever MANAGED is allowed; never for an E2EE-only context).

messages.description: Message features (platform policy version 4). Replies are always supported; a tenant may turn threads off (replies are kept without a thread root), reactions or pins.

deliveryReceipts.description: Other members learn when a message was DELIVERED to a recipient (messaging.delivery-cursor.updated / delivery-cursor.updated events).

revisionHistoryVisible.description: Members may read the kept revisions of edited MANAGED messages. Revisions are always kept (exports and legal holds include them).

EffectivePolicy.description: Platform defaults merged with the application's overrides (deterministic; stored as an immutable content-addressed snapshot). Platform policy version 3 (Parts E-G): attachments (off by default), editing windows, privacy of presence / typing / read receipts, retention, moderation, abuse limits; regulated context controls.

MemberRole.description: §30: OWNER (the owner), ADMIN, MODERATOR (moderates MEMBER / READ_ONLY / BOT_SERVICE members: remove, ban, unban; no role or ownership administration), MEMBER, READ_ONLY (reads its history window, sends no messages: READ_ONLY_MEMBER), BOT_SERVICE (BOT_OR_SERVICE principals only).

MessageLifecycle.description: ACTIVE carries content; every other state is a tombstone without content. HIDDEN_FOR_YOU: deleted on the reader's own devices only.

authoritySource.description: How the membership came to be: an administrator or the application backend (API), an accepted invitation, or the meeting integration.

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

role.description: BOT_SERVICE only for BOT_OR_SERVICE principals (BOT_SERVICE_REQUIRES_BOT_PRINCIPAL); bots are never ADMIN / MODERATOR (BOT_CANNOT_ADMINISTER).

invite.description: §35: invite instead of adding. The principal becomes INVITED (no history, no events, no sends) until it accepts (POST .../invitation/accept); invitations expire after 7 days and count toward the member limit.

cryptographicRemoval.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: the server-side removal is authorization only; a member's MLS commit removing the devices completes the cryptographic exclusion.

ciphertext.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: the MLS PrivateMessage (MLSMessage bytes, base64url). Never plaintext.

text.description: MANAGED plain text (UTF-8, 1-16384 characters, no control characters). No markup subset is defined: the server never interprets HTML, Markdown or scripts, stores the text exactly as given and returns it as a JSON string; clients render it as text (escaping it), never as markup.

notify.description: false: no push notification jobs (mirrored / migrated writes). Default true.

managedPresentation.description: MANAGED only (refused for PRIVATE_E2EE, whose presentation travels inside the ciphertext).

SendMessageRequest.description: Which fields apply is decided by the conversation's PERSISTED security profile: PRIVATE_E2EE needs deviceId, epoch and ciphertext and refuses text (CONTENT_REJECTED / PLAINTEXT_IN_E2EE); MANAGED needs text and refuses ciphertext.

e2ee.description: The protected envelope (Appendix H.1): version, protocol, cipher suite and the scope the client bound into the AAD; the server stores and relays the ciphertext without reading it.

securityProvenance.description: NATIVE: created through Messaging. LEGACY_MANAGED: imported from a legacy chat store (MANAGED only, never presented as end-to-end encrypted).

oneOf.description: LEGACY_MANAGED: the original time at the legacy source.

channel.description: IN_APP, or SMS: arrived through the SMS Bridge (MANAGED only; never end-to-end encrypted).

replyToMessageId.description: The message this one replies to (same conversation, within the sender's history window).

threadRootId.description: The root of the reply thread (the first message replied to).

Message.description: A message. Content (ciphertext or MANAGED text) only while ACTIVE. e2ee for PRIVATE_E2EE rows, managed for MANAGED rows; the acceptance digest binds the server sequence and id to the ciphertext (cfmeet-messaging-acceptance:v2).

PermalinkResolution.description: A permalink is never authority: resolution checks current membership; a non-member and an unknown id are the same NOT_FOUND.

text.description: MANAGED plain text (UTF-8, 1-16384 characters, no control characters). No markup subset is defined: the server never interprets HTML, Markdown or scripts, stores the text exactly as given and returns it as a JSON string; clients render it as text (escaping it), never as markup.

expectedEditCount.description: Optimistic version check: the editCount the editor last saw. If another edit committed first the request is refused with 409 VERSION_CONFLICT (reason EDITED_CONCURRENTLY). Omitted: last writer wins.

data.description: camelCase payload; message events carry the message's CURRENT representation (a deleted message replays as a tombstone).

ConversationEvent.description: A durable conversation event (derived from committed state, replayable by its per-conversation eventSequence). Every durable event names its tenant, application and environment (§117).

syncRequired.description: The requested position is older than the retained event window: resynchronize messages by sequence.

CommitRequest.description: An MLS Commit created in the group's current epoch. removedDeviceIds is the committer's attestation of the leaves it removes; while removals are pending it must cover them all.

ClientToken.description: A short-lived Messaging Client Access Token (compact JWS, EdDSA, typ cfmeet-mcat+jwt) bound to tenant, application, environment, principal, device and session. Device-direct use only: POST /v1/realtime/tickets.

RealtimeTicket.description: Single-use, seconds-long WebSocket ticket, presented as a Sec-WebSocket-Protocol entry (never in the URL).

pushDeliveryConfigured.description: false: no push adapter / credentials for this platform in this deployment; jobs end NOT_CONFIGURED (never reported delivered).

size.description: Exact byte size of the stored object (ciphertext for PRIVATE_E2EE).

mediaType.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: always application/octet-stream (the real type is protected inside MLS).

oneOf.description: MANAGED only: sanitized presentation name (never a storage key).
MANAGED only, client-declared presentation metadata (durations are NOT verified by the server).

scan.description: PRIVATE_E2EE attachments are ciphertext: never scanned and never reported as scanned (NOT_APPLICABLE_ENCRYPTED).

derivatives.description: Server-made derivatives (metadata reads only; empty for PRIVATE_E2EE).

Attachment.description: An attachment's authorized metadata and lifecycle. Bytes live in protected object storage under a server-generated key.

size.description: Exact byte size of the stored object (ciphertext for PRIVATE_E2EE).

mediaType.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: always application/octet-stream (the real type is protected inside MLS).

oneOf.description: MANAGED only: sanitized presentation name (never a storage key).
MANAGED only, client-declared presentation metadata (durations are NOT verified by the server).

scan.description: PRIVATE_E2EE attachments are ciphertext: never scanned and never reported as scanned (NOT_APPLICABLE_ENCRYPTED).

upload.description: A signed single-object upload bound to the exact size (content-length), SHA-256 (x-amz-checksum-sha256) and content type: the store rejects any other bytes. Send exactly these headers.

mediaType.description: MANAGED: required, in the kind's allow-list. PRIVATE_E2EE: omit (or application/octet-stream).

deviceId.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: the uploading device (the acting principal's).

residualAccessSeconds.description: A grant issued before a revocation stays usable at most this long; GET .../content re-checks authorization on every request.

AttachmentDownloadGrant.description: A short-lived signed read of one object forcing Content-Disposition: attachment and the stored content type. Issued only after authorization (current membership, history window, message ACTIVE, attachment READY).

LegalHold.description: A legal / compliance hold: held items are never purged or deleted. For PRIVATE_E2EE it preserves ciphertext and metadata only; it never creates a decryption capability.

SearchResults.description: Server search covers MANAGED conversations only; PRIVATE_E2EE conversations are searched on devices (LOCAL_SEARCH_ONLY).

disclosure.description: PRIVATE_E2EE only and optional: what the reporter's own device decrypted, disclosed voluntarily (sealed at rest; presented as unverifiable).

ReportReceipt.description: What the reporter learns: that the report was received. The reported principal is never told who reported.

ReportDetail.description: A report with its evidence (moderation.manage; audited as REPORT_VIEWED).

ModerationAction.description: Append-only; audited. No action reads PRIVATE_E2EE content.

DeletionRequest.description: Legal holds win: held items are preserved and counted (PARTIALLY_HELD).

SyncResult.description: applied=false: the update is stale or a replay (source version at or below the last applied one) and changed nothing.

items.description: The canonical Messaging message of every imported or already-imported legacy message (the legacy system's stable id mapping).

MeetingMessageModeration.description: Removal of a meeting-conversation message by the meeting authority (which already compared the host's role with the sender's). Idempotent.

ContextAuthorityUpdate.description: Part V H §103: the current authority of a peer-owned communication context (opaque reference only; never a telephone number or contact value). Version-fenced; REVOKED / SUSPENDED apply even to a suspended tenant, ACTIVE needs full authority.

SmsBridgeDisclosure.description: Part V H §106: the disclosure a bridge creator must acknowledge (version-pinned).

CreateSmsBridgeRequest.description: Bridge a MANAGED conversation to one external party by SMS. The number is passed to the SMS Gateway once and never stored by Messaging. A PRIVATE_E2EE conversation is never bridged (E2EE_CONVERSATION_NOT_BRIDGEABLE).

SmsTransport.description: Carrier state of one bridged message — separate from in-app delivery and read state (§110).

InboundSms.description: An inbound SMS of a bridged party (SMS Gateway → Messaging, messaging-sms-bridge.deliver).

pricing.description: Messaging records usage facts only; it never prices or bills.

UsageSummary.description: Usage facts of the caller's application environment (Part V I §129): quantities only, no price, rate or cost.

cosignedAtMicros.description: When the witness cosigned (Unix microseconds); signed.

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature over the length-prefixed encoding of label 'cfmeet-messaging-kt-witness-cosignature:v1', witnessId, logId, treeSize (u64 BE), rootHash, timestampMicros (i64 BE) and cosignedAtMicros (i64 BE) — packages/messaging-crypto transparency::witness_cosignature_input.

WitnessCosignature.description: One witness's cosignature of a tree head.

transferPublicKey.description: base64url X25519 HPKE public key (32 bytes) generated by the TARGET device for this transfer only.

expiresAt.description: At most one hour from now (whole seconds are signed).

requestSignature.description: Ed25519 signature by the TARGET device key over packages/messaging-crypto history_transfer::request_signing_input.

HistoryTransferRequest.description: A new device's request for the history its existing device holds (ADR 0052 AD-07).

HistoryTransfer.description: A device-to-device history transfer. Messaging relays an opaque sealed history between two ACTIVE devices of one principal; it holds no key that opens it (no recovery key, no escrow) and deletes the sealed bytes on completion, cancellation, revocation or expiry.

sealedHistory.description: base64url of the sealed history: HPKE (RFC 9180) ciphertext to the transfer key, signed by the SOURCE device (history_transfer::seal_history).

status.description: QUOTA_DEFERRED: the environment's storage budget has no room for the thumbnail. No object is stored or charged; the original attachment is unaffected; the derivative is retried later or when the attachment policy changes (errorCode STORAGE_BUDGET).

size.description: The stored object's actual bytes (THUMBNAIL), charged to the environment's storage budget alongside the original.

metadata.description: INSPECTION only: the measured facts (null for THUMBNAIL and until READY).

AttachmentDerivative.description: A server-made derivative of a MANAGED attachment: a re-encoded PNG thumbnail of an image without the original's metadata (THUMBNAIL), or the measured container, duration and dimensions of an image, voice note or video (INSPECTION, no object). Never produced for PRIVATE_E2EE attachments, whose thumbnails the sending client encrypts itself.

ThumbnailGrant.description: A short-lived read of a MANAGED image's thumbnail, authorized exactly like a download grant of the original.

durationMs.description: Measured from the bytes (null: the container records none).

durationMatchesDeclared.description: Declared vs measured within max(1 s, 5 %); null when either is absent.

MediaInspection.description: What the server measured in a READY MANAGED attachment's bytes (never inferred for PRIVATE_E2EE ciphertext).

MessageRevisionPage.description: The kept prior versions of a MANAGED message, oldest first (revision n = the text after n edits). Visible to members only when editing.revisionHistoryVisible; empty for a deleted message.

BackupIntentRequest.description: An upload intent for one client-encrypted backup object (Appendix I.3). The client encrypts with the shared crypto core under a root key only the user holds; the server never receives a key or content.

upload.description: A signed single-object upload bound to the exact size (content-length), SHA-256 (x-amz-checksum-sha256) and content type: the store rejects any other bytes. Send exactly these headers.

Backup.description: Metadata of an opaque backup object. keyId and clientBackupId come from the object's public header; the server cannot decrypt the object.

expiresAt.description: §49: optional pin expiry (in the future). An expired pin is no longer listed nor counted toward the limit; pinning again renews it.

PinRequest.description: Optional body of PUT /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/pins/{messageId}; an empty body pins without expiry.

unreadReplyCount.description: Replies from others after the caller's read cursor.

ThreadSummary.description: §47: a thread's reply count, last reply and the caller's unread replies, counted only inside the caller's history window (active, not hidden).

InvitationList.description: The acting principal's open (unexpired) invitations to ACTIVE conversations, newest first.
